{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check premises
loyal_count = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'].shape[0]

# Report findings
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Rows with customer_segment == 'loyal': {loyal_count}")
print(f"Unique customer_segment values: {df['customer_segment'].unique()}")

# Check if 'converted' is binary
print(f"Unique values in 'converted': {df['converted'].unique()}")

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 in customer_age: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check revenue format
print(f"First 5 revenue values: {df['revenue'].head().tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == '999999.99'): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")"}
